summary: What keeps me at the keyboard is watching separate pieces — services, queues, retrieval pipelines — come together into something that works. I found backend engineering later than most, recognized it immediately, and went all in: building nearly every day since July 2025, completing Boot.dev's Backend Developer Path twice (once in Python/Go, again in TypeScript) because one pass wasn't enough to satisfy me. Now I'm architecting BlightSanest, a multi-service RAG platform, and looking for a team where I can keep building things like it.

projects.name: BlightSanest — Stable Insights
projects.description: Privacy-first smart journaling platform: users store personal data across any domain and query it conversationally through RAG or directly through hybrid search.
bullets: Architected three services — Go API orchestrator, Python RAG engine, Go pub/sub — communicating over gRPC, with per-user isolated indexes for privacy by design.
Implemented hybrid retrieval: BM25 and semantic embeddings (Sentence Transformers, pgvector) fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion; Ollama for local LLM, AWS Bedrock in production.
Built pre-computed indexing pipeline with S3 as source of truth, Redis hot cache with automatic fallback, MessagePack serialization, and Alembic schema migrations.
RAG service phase complete; production design targets Aurora Serverless, EKS, and Cognito with a full Docker Compose local stack.

projects.name: AI Damage-Claim Verification Agent
projects.description: 24-hour hackathon (HackerRank Orchestrate, June 2026). Multimodal pipeline that decides whether submitted images support, contradict, or insufficiently evidence damage claims across cars, laptops, and packages.
bullets: Combined CLIP (clip-ViT-L-14) image–text similarity for damage type, severity, and image-quality classification with a local Llama 3.2 model (Ollama) producing validated 14-field structured verdicts.
Designed modular agent architecture (vision RAG layer → context organizer → LLM reasoner) with tunable evidence thresholds calibrated against labeled sample data.

projects.name: Reargs Similarity API
projects.description: Semantic document-analysis API that detects patterns, redundancies, and similarities across uploaded documents (.txt, .md, .pdf).
bullets: Automatic clustering via vector embeddings, natural-language querying of similar content, and LLM-powered generation from selected clusters.
Deployed with a live public demo; GitHub Actions CI runs tests on every push; multi-stage Docker build.
